extraPatterns.name: hypercube_tesseract
extraPatterns.label: Tesseract Hypercube
extraPatterns.fn: (x, y) => { const dx = Math.abs(x - 7.5); const dy = Math.abs(y - 7.5); return (dx <= 5 && dy <= 5 && (dx === 5 || dy === 5)) || (dx <= 2 && dy <= 2 && (dx === 2 || dy === 2)) || Math.abs(dx - dy) < 0.8; }

extraPatterns.name: supernova_blast
extraPatterns.label: Souffle de Supernova
extraPatterns.fn: (x, y) => { const d = Math.hypot(x - 7.5, y - 7.5); const a = Math.atan2(y - 7.5, x - 7.5); return d < 2.0 || Math.sin(a * 10 - d * 0.8) > 0.45; }

extraPatterns.name: valkyrie_runic_ring
extraPatterns.label: Rune Runique Valkyrie
extraPatterns.fn: (x, y) => { const d = Math.hypot(x - 7.5, y - 7.5); const a = Math.atan2(y - 7.5, x - 7.5); return Math.abs(d - 5) < 1.2 && Math.cos(a * 8) > 0.1; }

extraPatterns.name: vortex_maelstrom
extraPatterns.label: Maelström Océanique
extraPatterns.fn: (x, y) => { const d = Math.hypot(x - 7.5, y - 7.5); return Math.sin(d * 1.5 + Math.atan2(y - 7.5, x - 7.5) * 3) > 0.35; }

extraPatterns.name: solar_flare_loops
extraPatterns.label: Boucles Coronales
extraPatterns.fn: (x, y) => { const dx = x - 7.5; const dy = y - 7.5; return Math.abs(dx * dx + dy * dy - 25) < 7 && Math.abs(dx) > 1; }

extraPatterns.name: cyber_hazard_cross
extraPatterns.label: Croix de Danger Cyber
extraPatterns.fn: (x, y) => { const dx = Math.abs(x - 7.5); const dy = Math.abs(y - 7.5); return (dx <= 6 && dy <= 2) || (dy <= 6 && dx <= 2); }

extraPatterns.name: emp_core_rings
extraPatterns.label: Noyau IEM Résonant
extraPatterns.fn: (x, y) => { const d = Math.hypot(x - 7.5, y - 7.5); return Math.floor(d) === 2 || Math.floor(d) === 4 || Math.floor(d) === 6; }

extraPatterns.name: radar_sweep_lines
extraPatterns.label: Balayage Radar
extraPatterns.fn: (x, y) => { const a = Math.atan2(y - 7.5, x - 7.5); return Math.abs(a - 0.7) < 0.25 || Math.hypot(x - 7.5, y - 7.5) === 5; }

extraPatterns.name: command_diamond_chevron
extraPatterns.label: Chevrons de Commandement
extraPatterns.fn: (x, y) => { const dx = Math.abs(x - 7.5); return Math.abs(y - dx) < 1.1 || Math.abs(y - (dx + 4)) < 1.1; }
